text: As artificial intelligence becomes more common in our daily lives, ethical questions are increasingly important. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from their training data. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so developers must work hard to ensure fairness for everyone. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often relies on large amounts of personal information. Companies should collect and use this data carefully and honestly. Transparency is also essential: people deserve to know how AI makes decisions that affect them. Ultimately, responsible AI development means putting human values first and making sure technology benefits society as a whole.
